ch07.alt: A black-and-white portrait photograph of Chen Yangshan as a younger man, wearing a Red Army field cap and a plain tunic, his head slightly turned.
ch07.caption: Chen Yangshan (1906–1991). The frontispiece portrait from the source; the dates are the source's caption.

ch08.alt: A facsimile of a handwritten letter on ruled paper, two blocks of Chinese cursive script, signed and dated at the foot.
ch08.caption: Chen Yangshan's letter of June 14, 1988, in his own hand. A typeset transcription follows.

ch08.alt: A facsimile of a handwritten page listing thirty-six short numbered items in Chinese cursive script, set out in rough columns.
ch08.caption: Chen Yangshan's handwritten outline for the memoir he never wrote. The typeset list follows.

ch08.alt: A facsimile of a handwritten page of thirteen numbered household precepts in Chinese cursive script.
ch08.caption: Chen Yangshan's household precepts in his own hand. The typeset text follows.
